transcription_check.scope: All twenty assigned PDF pages rendered and visually compared with extracted text. Faithful to the defective digital witness; not archival verification. Same-agent source/English alignment pass; no independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l008: Баабедин retained as Baabedin: Bahauddin, a sacred protector invoked in Central Asian epics; also the offering made in his name. Here invocation is selected. бат may mean quickly or be defective бата; no silent correction. https://el-sozduk.kg/баабедин/
notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l012: умачтай көзү ачылуу is rendered idiomatically eyes opened wide; literal food simile not expanded into a new image. Same idiom recurs p103:l007.
notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l015: акылдап interpreted as pounding in the heart context; likely defective spelling, retained unchanged in source.
notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l016: такылдан interpreted as tapping, likely defective for такылдап; visible spelling preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l024: кадыр түн rendered Night of Power; religious and figurative auspicious-night senses overlap here. No calendar date asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l028: Алды каткан is uncertain; anguished is contextual, rather than a silently supplied reading арды каткан.
notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l033: Супа садык is interpreted as subh-i sadiq, true dawn; visible reflowed witness form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l034: Taraza retained as the star-name; no confident modern constellation identification asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0096:b002:l042: күлдөй literally like ash retained despite oddity in a good-fortune context; possible defect not silently emended.
notes.manas-2010:p0097:b002:l006: Торучаар retained as Toruchaar, a horse name containing bay/spotted coloring; no separate modern horse-breed identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0097:b002:l014: жат literally stranger/alien: implication may be that asking for the prized horse ruptures friendship; ambiguity preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0097:b002:l018: Lead-rope down to a handspan is retained; worn is contextual, not expressly stated in Kyrgyz.
notes.manas-2010:p0097:b002:l022: мүчө сөгүлгөн literally limbs coming loose; interpreted as limbs loosening for movement, not injury.
notes.manas-2010:p0097:b002:l025: очогор: epic firearm in Yudakhin, matchlock in 2015 explanatory dictionary. Name retained with gun; no invented mechanism/caliber. https://el-sozduk.kg/очогор/
notes.manas-2010:p0097:b002:l036: кийик is a wild ungulate; wild goat chosen from cliff/stone context, species identification provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0097:b002:l037: шарт is uncertain in this construction; nimble is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0097:b002:l043: кара байыр казанат rendered hardy well-bred horse; distinction between horse categories remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0098:b002:l018: көңүлү бөлүнүү interpreted as troubled/distracted here by longing for a rider; joy/grief shift follows immediate context.
notes.manas-2010:p0098:b002:l026: Invocation Baabedin retained; see p96:l008 and https://el-sozduk.kg/баабедин/.
notes.manas-2010:p0098:b002:l028: Боконо жүрөк combines ribs and heart unusually; both retained, following prior lexical check of боконо as ribs.
notes.manas-2010:p0098:b002:l039: Телкүрөң rendered Telküröng, the named mount; source name retained, no horse identification added.
notes.manas-2010:p0098:b002:l044: сүйүнчүлөө includes announcing good news and asking its customary reward; English keeps the reward claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0099:b002:l005: заар can mean venom/menace; menace is provisional, preserving the statement that he holds it in both hands rather than anticipating the blood/gold description.
notes.manas-2010:p0099:b002:l009: башыл likely defective баштуу (headed); ирик denotes a wether/castrated ram, biologically incongruous at birth. English ram is provisional; the source anomaly is not resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0099:b002:l016: Кара кандай interpreted as кара канды, black blood, from the repeated adjacent blood lines; visible form preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0099:b002:l025: сүрүнөтү interpreted as circumcision, related to сүннөт; visible form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0099:b002:l026: бышмана rendered distressed; exact emotional nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0099:b002:l036: Nine old women retained exactly; later p108:l025 says twelve women. No harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0099:b002:l042: тоюнду literally became full/sated; light filled him is contextual; precise syntax remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0100:b002:l024: His forehead reached earth retained; antecedent could be child or lion, not securely resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0100:b002:l030: Ninety thousand lives retained as explicit epic hyperbole; no simplification to immensely strong.
notes.manas-2010:p0100:b002:l038: Ааламда жок literally absent/nonexistent in the world; none like him selected contextually, rather than a prophecy of disappearance.
notes.manas-2010:p0101:b002:l012: Кызыр (Kyzyr) treated as variant of Kydyr to maintain established name consistency; source spelling retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0101:b002:l023: Жакында literally soon/near; readily is provisional in the dream-coming-true context.
notes.manas-2010:p0101:b002:l025: Жадыда interpreted as in memory; possible alternate reading not resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0101:b002:l028: Girding about the waist retained as the support metaphor; not turned into literal carrying a lion.
notes.manas-2010:p0101:b002:l034: Муңун табар literally find their grief retained; expected ease/remove their grief is not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0102:b002:l010: койдой literally like sheep retained; precise simile is uncertain in humiliation context.
notes.manas-2010:p0102:b002:l021: Эйрен retained as Eyren, epic place-name; not independently geolocated.
notes.manas-2010:p0102:b002:l042: кен literally mine/treasure selected rather than silently changing to эр, hero.
notes.manas-2010:p0103:b002:l007: Repeated умачтай көзү ачылуу rendered eyes open wide, as p96:l012.
notes.manas-2010:p0103:b002:l034: Казыналык interpreted as in royal/state service; exact court office unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0103:b002:l047: Тутанып өлгөн is grammatically past but used as a curse here; may he burn to death is contextual. кызыталак rendered bastard as functional abuse, not a literal claim of illegitimacy.
notes.manas-2010:p0104:b002:l001: Каяшаяк interpreted as answering back, related to каяша; visible anomalous spelling retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0104:b002:l026: Contextually retranslated from the complete formula Ордолуу шайык көк жөкөр. Primary 1960 Semetey glossary PDF374 explicitly identifies it as an epithet of Kokand: great/holy/famous city and capital inhabited by many sheikhs. The complete formula, source image and adjacent Kyrgyz verses were individually reviewed; ordinary жөкөр dictionary footwear/retainer senses do not govern this geographic formula. Original raw text, IDs, coordinates and source lineation remain unchanged. Formula immediately precedes Kokon/Margalang, followed by reported violence against them; geographic population list.
notes.manas-2010:p0104:b002:l036: өлгөндө көргөн literally had/encountered at death; in his dying days is provisional. Does not assert a historical birth/death date.
notes.manas-2010:p0104:b002:l037: талмызы unresolved and retained as talmyz; dictionary lookup failed. Jeti-Özön preserved as an epic place-name. The whole line remains translated but needs specialist lexical review.
notes.manas-2010:p0104:b002:l038: Repeated at-death birth formula retained as in his dying days; see p104:l036.
notes.manas-2010:p0104:b002:l040: Салым кылып алтынды interpreted as loading/consigning gold for trade; exact commercial/tax sense unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0104:b002:l042: Курун селде чалынып literally suggests winding belt as turban; retained, although likely defective conjunction/formula is possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0105:b002:l001: Медиян retained as Mediyan, possibly a place-name or descriptive barren-place term; identification unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0105:b002:l024: Height and forty rope-lengths retained as written for the dungeon; not silently changed to depth.
notes.manas-2010:p0105:b002:l027: бакырча rendered poor wretches contextually, from бакыр, poor; exact form unresolved and lookup failed.
notes.manas-2010:p0105:b002:l043: Чоң Жинди retained as Chong Jindi; literally Great/Big Madman, a concealing nickname for Manas. No name omission.
notes.manas-2010:p0106:b002:l017: Алдам interpreted as my God/Allah, consistent with the surrounding invocation; otherwise is supplied to express the conditional idiom, exact syntax provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0106:b002:l022: Six san retained; san is an epic multitude unit, not expanded into an invented exact count.
notes.manas-2010:p0106:b002:l032: Extractor split Эч from the rest of a single visually continuous baseline. Both original IDs retained as separate provisional translation rows, not asserted to be separate performed verse lines.
notes.manas-2010:p0106:b002:l033: Shares the visible baseline with p106:l032; source segmentation retained under provisional lineation.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l002: Алдыңкы literally front/forward lip; lower lip selected from repeated camel formula, exact form preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l003: Two humps retained, although p107:l005 immediately describes one hump; no harmonization of the camel descriptions.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l009: нар retained as nar, a camel category; exact hybrid/dromedary identification not imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l014: сүрөк unresolved; milch cows supplied contextually from сүтү май and the cattle gift, not a verified lexical equivalent. Dictionary lookup failed.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l016: Малым жетпейт бир далай literally many of my livestock do not reach/match; beyond many of my livestock is provisional, retaining the unexpected first person.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l025: өгөө=file, бүлөө=whetstone selected as a parallel implement pair; бүлөө could alternatively evoke household/family. Wordplay or defective reading remains possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l027: Алтайга таштап literally leaving in Altai; English supplies me from the first-person gift speech, not changing source case ending.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l030: If it will not hurt retained despite absurdity before the eye-gouging offer; no sentimental paraphrase.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l032: дүйнөсүз literally without world/wealth; without worldly joy is provisional in the childlessness lament.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l039: Кебин угуп кан Балтай is syntactically ambiguous: Baltay could be subject hearing words, but surrounding first-person speech favors hearing Khan Baltay’s words. Draft follows that reading without changing source.
notes.manas-2010:p0107:b002:l048: бок rendered shit, preserving the coarse register.
notes.manas-2010:p0108:b002:l002: Бир туткан бирим may be defective пирим (my spiritual guide); literal one I held to retained, not silently emended.
notes.manas-2010:p0108:b002:l007: Parenthetical (түмөн) visibly present in witness retained as (countless); may be editorial alternate wording/gloss, authorship unverified. Whole underlying verse row retained; no exact ten-thousand expansion.
notes.manas-2010:p0108:b002:l009: тутамга келбей literally not fitting a handspan retained; emotional collapse/excitement implication remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0108:b002:l025: Twelve women retained despite nine in the earlier report p99:l036.
notes.manas-2010:p0108:b002:l029: Repeated бар-бар-бар retained as onomatopoeic Bar, bar, bar; not translated as the lexical command go.
notes.manas-2010:p0108:b002:l030: бек could mean lord or intensifier firmly/strongly; lord chosen, while roared preserves force. Ambiguous.
notes.manas-2010:p0108:b002:l037: Байда interpreted contextually as пайда, appeared; visible form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0109:b002:l004: себилдүү means equipped/armed; eighty-four retained with implicit referent as in earlier batch p63:l034, not confidently assigned to companions or individual weapons. https://el-sozduk.kg/себил/
notes.manas-2010:p0109:b002:l011: түтоо/tүтоо renewal formula interpreted renewed whenever brought to an end; exact morphology of түтөгөн remains provisional, possibly smoke/fire imagery.
notes.manas-2010:p0109:b002:l013: Repeated death/growth paradox retained literally, not rewritten as never dying.
notes.manas-2010:p0109:b002:l037: күпсөр is leather powder container in Yudakhin and explanatory dictionaries. https://el-sozduk.kg/күпсөр/
notes.manas-2010:p0109:b002:l041: Каалап берген literally granted by choosing/willing; steel bullet granted by choice retained; giver implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0109:b002:l047: оозандыр means put into the mouth/give to suck; infant’s ritual first taste of steel bullet retained. Does not say swallow it. https://el-sozduk.kg/оозандыр/
notes.manas-2010:p0110:b002:l008: Даарымак rendered bless/touch with sacred influence in the saint’s visitation context; exact ritual action not asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0110:b002:l012: Dative Жакыпка forms an awkward transition; retained as to Jakyp rather than silently altered to nominative.
notes.manas-2010:p0110:b002:l021: No child retained within the recalled childless description despite present birth; no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0110:b002:l022: Баалуу literally valuable/precious retained; possible defective Балалуу (having a child) noted but not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0110:b002:l027: Five hundred beginning/headed by mares retained, not claiming all were mares; later speaker p112:l041 says five hundred mares.
notes.manas-2010:p0110:b002:l041: зарып likely related to сарп (expended); slaughtered for feast contextual, visible form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0110:b002:l047: кочку is Kalmyk village headman per Yudakhin; plural retained. https://el-sozduk.kg/кочку/
notes.manas-2010:p0110:b002:l048: таштуу refers to officials wearing stone rank-badges on headgear, not stone worshippers; see primary explanatory entry https://el-sozduk.kg/tash--2/.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l004: Башаалыктай/Баашалыктай throughout speech interpreted as like a padishah/emperor; spelling varies in witness, exact title nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l007: аш literally food/nourishment retained for both kymyz and liquor; abundance is contextual but not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l015: Stone rank-badges, as p110:l048; same convention applies p111:l036.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l026: душаңы retained as dushangs, an apparent Kalmyk title/group in this context; exact identification unresolved, lookup failed.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l030: Сөөк терин сызышып literally drawing sweat from bones; sweating from their very bones preserves the hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l037: тазалары interpreted finest/foremost in officials context; could indicate all/entire group, nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l041: Ошпурбай/Oшпур retained as Oshpurbay/Oshpur; no conflation with Akbaltay.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l048: Plural they anticipates Black Kalmyks/Manchus on next page; not assigned to Oshpur, who reports the gossip afterward.
notes.manas-2010:p0112:b002:l011: Күрдөлү interpreted as prosperous prime/full bloom of wealth; exact syntax provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0112:b002:l031: Каканчын-Бакбурчун kept as Kakanchyn-Bakburchun; compound may mix title/name/place, not independently identified.
notes.manas-2010:p0112:b002:l033: Fragmented source syntax across l031–034 retained; no missing narrative clause invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0112:b002:l045: Five hundred camels retained in this speech, not conflated with earlier four hundred camels gifted to Baltay.
notes.manas-2010:p0113:b002:l016: сыйгыз interpreted contextually as сыйгыс, unable to fit; source form retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0113:b002:l017: Ulungtung, Dang-Shang, Bakburchun transliterate the three source forms; title/personal-name status unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0113:b002:l025: уча is rump/saddle meat portion at feasts; tying portions to guests/children for carrying away is contextual interpretation. No extra quantity invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0113:b002:l040: белине literally waist/ridge/support; stronghold is provisional in the chain of destination phrases.
notes.manas-2010:p0113:b002:l042: Сепил тозгон interpreted as fortifications set around/against; visible тозгон retained, no silent correction to тосгон/tоскон.
notes.manas-2010:p0114:b002:l001: Gripping handle of copper kettledrum retained despite object/action awkwardness; no replacement with a weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p0114:b002:l017: жайсаң retained as jaysang, a rank/title; exact official equivalence unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0114:b002:l019: күрөө IV is Kalmyk monastery in Yudakhin; not collateral/jugular senses. https://el-sozduk.kg/күрөө/
notes.manas-2010:p0114:b002:l021: Ox aging and self dying retained literally; exact referent and religious-practice connection uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0114:b002:l024: сетер көтөрүү means consecrating livestock/releasing it as sacred, per Yudakhin and 2015 explanatory dictionary; lead goat rendering for серке. https://el-sozduk.kg/сетер/
notes.manas-2010:p0114:b002:l027: Celibacy statement retained as the narrator’s depiction of monks, not independently asserted ethnographic fact.
notes.manas-2010:p0114:b002:l036: кара баскан evokes a harmful spirit afflicting a woman, especially childbirth; demon-struck wife retained as simile, not a medical claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0115:b002:l012: Качан болсо арыкта бар is visibly present and unresolved; literal at any time there is some in the ditch retained. Missing object/possible defective word requires comparison with another witness; no omitted verse or invented replacement.
notes.manas-2010:p0115:b002:l022: Looking livestock in the eye is a rhetorical idiom for sparing/being reluctant to slaughter them; literal image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0115:b002:l033: Адам бир деген оңобу is syntactically uncertain; can one called a man prosper so is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0115:b002:l039: бучкак rendered trouser-leg, retaining the contemptuous comparison; precise idiomatic nuance may be not worth a corner/edge.
notes.manas-2010:p0111:b002:l036: Lexical correction: таш сайынган means a Chinese/Kalmyk official wearing a distinguishing ball/button on the cap, Yudakhin таш I.5 https://el-sozduk.kg/таш/. In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.
